verdict.rationale: GitHub exposes REST/GraphQL APIs, a CLI, and an MCP server (github-probe-3, github-probe-4, github-docs-18/19) that could be scripted to perform bulk operations across issues, PRs, or repos, and Actions/CI-CD (github-docs-11) can automate repetitive tasks. However, no evidence explicitly documents a native 'bulk operations' feature or AI-native batch-processing capability across many items—Copilot agent examples (github-docs-2/13) focus on single-file/task edits, not bulk actions.
